author: Andrew
course_notes: Nearly every green runs back to front. Long is usually dead; miss short and stay below the hole.

levels.dead: penalty, lost ball, or near-certain double

notes: Green runs back to front. Stay below the hole.
Long-left is the worst miss on the hole.
Never left or long. The fall-off left and long-left is bare ground.
Drive it right-center. Left at 270 is blocked by a tree.
Green runs away from you. Long is dead: bare lies.
The bank just right of the green feeds misses back toward it.

zones.label: Go zone: right-center of the fairway
Right: sandy area, tree blocks the green
Left at 270: tree blocks the view
Just right: bank funnels it back
Way right: chipping down the slope
Long: bare lies, green runs away

notes: Severe back-to-front green. Stay below the hole at all costs.
Land it no further than hole high. Spinny green, short club in.
Fast days (10+): from above the hole you can putt it off the green.

caddy.why: Severe back-to-front slope; above the hole is a likely 3-putt or worse.

notes: {plan} off the tee, not driver: the fairway shrinks from 34 yds wide at 200 to 16 at 280.
235–240 off the tee leaves a full sand wedge.
Anything right off the tee is out of bounds (playground fence).
Long is dead: swale behind the green.

caddy.why: Fairway narrows to 16 yds at 280 with a bunker left; OB right. Laying back to ~235 leaves a full wedge.

zones.label: Go zone: lay up to the wide part
Left: trees short of the bunker
Long and far left off the tee
Left: bare lies, green pitches away

notes: Go for it: a three-quarter {plan}. Being up near the green makes more birdies than laying back.
If you miss, miss short: short-left and short-right both leave a wide green.
Two bunkers right of the green, at ~220 and ~240 off the tee.
Left and long-left are trees: dead.

options.name: go
options.target: up around the green, short of center; long is dead
options.why: A three-quarter swing allows for a mishit or wind into the face; being up near the green makes more birdies than laying back.

options.name: layup
options.side: right half of the fairway, up to 10 yds right of it

zones.label: Bunker right of the green (~240 off the tee)
Bunker right of the green (~220 off the tee)
zones.note: Not in the map data; placed from Andrew's description. Check on the course.

notes: {plan} off the tee. Usually finishes a little short, which is fine.
The tree ~130 out on the right overhangs the fairway. The uphill tee lie promotes a draw, but you need a cut.
The only real disaster is the bunker left of the green. Leave it short of it.

caddy.why: Tree ~130 out on the right overhangs the fairway; the uphill tee lie promotes a draw.
caddy.aim: short or short-right of the green; never the left bunker

zones.label: Overhanging tree (right side, ~130 off the tee)
zones.note: Tree sits right; its branches overhang the fairway. Placed from Andrew's description.

notes: Long par 3: 184 front, 194 center, 204 back. Between clubs, club down. Short is fine.
The bunker short-right isn't penal: lots of green to work with.
Far left is dead: a swale with bald lies leaves a high shot off a bare lie. Long is dead too.

caddy.why: Short is fine; left and long are the trouble.

zones.label: Left side of the hole and green

notes: {plan} off the tee leaves a wedge and is easier to control. Driver only when you're driving it well (gets to ~50 out).
The fairway cants right to left past 230. Hug the right side.
OB left: parking-lot fence. Eucalyptus right. A straight ball, not a long one.
Around the green, long, left and right are all dead. Miss short or short-right.

options.name: layup
options.target: right half of the fairway (cants right to left past 230)
options.why: Leaves a wedge; easier to control.

options.name: driver
options.result: can get to ~50 yds or closer
